# TaskNet Grammar
# Auto-generated from tasknet_parser.py by extract_grammar.py -- do not edit by hand.
# Note: IMPLIES is the '->' token, IMPLIES_KW is the 'implies' keyword (both are equivalent)

start :
   tasknet

tasknet :
   TASKNET NAME LBRACE tasknet_body_items RBRACE

tasknet_body_items :
   tasknet_body_item
 | tasknet_body_items tasknet_body_item

tasknet_body_item :
   end_decl
 | timelines_block
 | initial_block
 | final_block
 | invariant_block
 | task_def
 | constraints_tl_block
 | properties_block
 | PARAM NAME EQ param_value SEMI

end_decl :
   END EQ NUMBER SEMI

timelines_block :
   TIMELINES LBRACE timeline_decl_list RBRACE

timeline_decl_list :
   empty
 | timeline_decl_list timeline_decl
 | timeline_decl

timeline_decl :
   NAME COLON timeline_kind SEMI

timeline_kind :
   STATE LPAREN state_list RPAREN EQ NAME
 | STATE LPAREN state_list RPAREN EQ NUMBER
 | ATOMIC init_int_opt
 | claim_kw range_opt init_opt
 | cumul_kw range_opt bounds_opt init_opt
 | RATE range_opt bounds_opt init_opt initial_rate_opt

state_list :
   NAME
 | NUMBER
 | state_list COMMA NAME
 | state_list COMMA NUMBER

claim_kw :
   CLAIM
 | CLAIMABLE

cumul_kw :
   CUMUL
 | CUMULATIVE

range :
   LBRACKET NUMBER COMMA NUMBER RBRACKET

range_opt :
   empty
 | range

bounds_opt :
   empty
 | BOUNDS range

init_opt :
   empty
 | EQ NUMBER

initial_rate_opt :
   empty
 | INITIAL_RATE EQ NUMBER

init_int_opt :
   empty
 | EQ NUMBER

initial_block :
   INITIAL LBRACE tlcon_list RBRACE

final_block :
   FINAL LBRACE tlcon_list RBRACE
 | FINAL WITHIN INITIAL LBRACE tlcon_list RBRACE
 | FINAL WITHIN INITIAL SEMI

invariant_block :
   INVARIANT LBRACE tlcon_list RBRACE
 | INVARIANT COMPOSITIONAL LBRACE tlcon_list RBRACE

task_def :
   TASKDEF NAME LBRACE task_body_items RBRACE
 | task_modifier_opt TASK NAME extends_opt LBRACE task_body_items RBRACE
 | task_modifier_opt TASK NAME extends_opt SEMI
 | task_modifier_opt TASK NAME LBRACKET NUMBER DOTDOT NUMBER RBRACKET extends_opt LBRACE task_body_items RBRACE
 | task_modifier_opt TASK NAME LBRACKET NUMBER RBRACKET extends_opt LBRACE task_body_items RBRACE
 | task_modifier_opt TASK NAME LBRACKET NUMBER DOTDOT NUMBER RBRACKET extends_opt SEMI
 | task_modifier_opt TASK NAME LBRACKET NUMBER RBRACKET extends_opt SEMI

task_modifier_opt :
   empty
 | OPTIONAL
 | REQUEST

extends_opt :
   empty
 | COLON NAME

task_body_items :
   empty
 | task_body_item
 | task_body_items task_body_item

task_body_item :
   task_id
 | task_priority
 | task_start_range
 | task_end_range
 | task_duration_range
 | task_duration
 | task_start_opt
 | task_after
 | task_containedin
 | param_block
 | constraints_block
 | pre_block
 | inv_block
 | post_block
 | task_impacts
 | task_def

task_id :
   ID_KW NUMBER SEMI

task_priority :
   PRIORITY NUMBER SEMI

task_start_range :
   START_RANGE range SEMI

task_end_range :
   END_RANGE range SEMI

task_duration_range :
   DURATION_RANGE range SEMI

task_duration :
   DURATION value SEMI

task_start_opt :
   START_KW NUMBER SEMI
 | empty

task_after :
   AFTER after_list SEMI

after_list :
   empty
 | after_item
 | after_list COMMA after_item

after_item :
   NAME
 | NAME LBRACKET NUMBER COMMA NUMBER RBRACKET
 | NAME NUMBER

task_containedin :
   CONTAINEDIN containedin_list SEMI

containedin_list :
   empty
 | containedin_item
 | containedin_list COMMA containedin_item

containedin_item :
   NAME
 | NAME offset offset
 | NAME NUMBER

offset :
   LBRACKET NUMBER COMMA NUMBER RBRACKET
 | NUMBER

name_list :
   empty
 | NAME
 | name_list COMMA NAME

constraints_block :
   CONSTRAINTS LBRACE constraints_items RBRACE

constraints_items :
   empty
 | constraints_item
 | constraints_items constraints_item

constraints_item :
   pre_block
 | inv_block
 | post_block

pre_block :
   PRE LBRACE tlcon_list RBRACE

inv_block :
   INV LBRACE tlcon_list RBRACE

post_block :
   POST LBRACE tlcon_list RBRACE

tlcon_list :
   empty
 | tlcon_stmt
 | tlcon_list tlcon_stmt

tlcon_stmt :
   NAME EQ value SEMI
 | NAME IN con_list SEMI

con_list :
   con_item
 | con_list con_item

con_item :
   value
 | range

task_impacts :
   impacts_block
 | empty

impacts_block :
   IMPACTS LBRACE impact_group_list RBRACE

impact_group_list :
   empty
 | impact_group
 | impact_group_list impact_group

impact_group :
   impact_when LBRACE impact_group_entries RBRACE

impact_when :
   PRE
 | MAINT
 | POST

impact_group_entries :
   empty
 | impact_group_entry
 | impact_group_entries impact_group_entry

impact_group_entry :
   NAME impact_rhs SEMI

impact_rhs :
   EQ value
 | PLUS_EQ NUMBER
 | MINUS_EQ NUMBER
 | PLUS_RATE NUMBER
 | MINUS_RATE NUMBER
 | ASSIGN_RATE NUMBER

constraints_tl_block :
   CONSTRAINTS LBRACE temporal_prop_list RBRACE

properties_block :
   PROPERTIES LBRACE temporal_prop_list RBRACE

temporal_prop_list :
   empty
 | temporal_prop
 | temporal_prop_list temporal_prop

temporal_prop :
   PROP NAME COLON tl_formula SEMI
 | tl_formula SEMI

tl_formula :
   tl_imp

tl_imp :
   tl_or
 | tl_or IMPLIES tl_imp
 | tl_or IMPLIES_KW tl_imp

tl_or :
   tl_and
 | tl_or OR tl_and

tl_and :
   tl_u
 | tl_and AND tl_u

tl_u :
   tl_unary
 | tl_unary UNTIL tl_unary
 | tl_unary SINCE tl_unary

tl_unary :
   NOT tl_unary
 | ALWAYS tl_unary
 | EVENTUALLY tl_unary
 | SOFAR tl_unary
 | ONCE tl_unary
 | LPAREN tl_formula RPAREN
 | tl_atom

tl_atom :
   NAME cmp_op NUMBER
 | NAME EQ NAME
 | NAME EQ TRUE
 | NAME EQ FALSE
 | ACTIVE LPAREN NAME RPAREN
 | TRUE
 | FALSE
 | TIME cmp_op NUMBER
 | TIME cmp_op NAME DOT START_KW
 | TIME cmp_op NAME DOT END
 | NAME DOT START_KW cmp_op NUMBER
 | NAME DOT END cmp_op NUMBER
 | NAME DOT START_KW cmp_op NAME DOT START_KW
 | NAME DOT START_KW cmp_op NAME DOT END
 | NAME DOT END cmp_op NAME DOT START_KW
 | NAME DOT END cmp_op NAME DOT END
 | SEQUENCE LBRACKET task_name_list RBRACKET
 | MUTEX LBRACKET task_name_list RBRACKET
 | MUTEX CROSS LBRACKET task_name_list RBRACKET
 | MUTEX LBRACKET task_name_list RBRACKET WITH LBRACKET task_name_list RBRACKET

task_name_list :
   NAME
 | task_name_list COMMA NAME

cmp_op :
   LT
 | LE
 | EQ
 | GE
 | GT

value :
   STRING
 | NUMBER
 | TRUE
 | FALSE
 | NAME

   PARAM LBRACE param_decl_list RBRACE

 | param_decl
 | param_decl_list param_decl

param_decl :
   NAME EQ param_value SEMI

 | LBRACKET NUMBER COMMA NUMBER RBRACKET
